description: Land Title Settlement Department - Eth Oya, Ratnapura D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620290
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and property registrations. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership information, extents, and legal status - all falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
